Indian Airforce Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant 02/2027 Exam City / Admit Card - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has released the exam city / admit card for the post of Group ‘Y’ Medical Assistant Airmen trade (Intake 02/2027). Online applying process for Indian Airforce Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant 02/2027 Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 July 2026 to 26 July 2026. The written examination is going to conducted on 22-23 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Airforce Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant 02/2027 Exam City / Admit Card 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 July 2026
  • Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 05-07 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 22-23 September 2026
  • Exam City Intimation: 11 September 2026
  • Admit Card: 24-48 Hours Before the Exam Date

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 550/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
